transformer.name: infinispan:embeddings
transformer.title: Infinispan (Embeddings)
transformer.description: Prepares the message to become an object writable by the Infinispan component

transformerIn.description: The body is not read: the embedding comes from the CamelLangChain4jEmbeddingsVector header and the text from the CamelLangChain4jEmbeddingsTextSegment header

transformerOut.description: The body is kept: the embedding goes in the CamelInfinispanValue header, or a vector query in the CamelInfinispanQueryBuilder header for QUERY. Without the embedding header nothing is set
